title: U-STS-LLM: A Unified Spatio-Temporal Steered Large Language Model for Traffic Prediction and Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2605.11735v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate spatio-temporal cellular traffic analysis is fundamental to the reliable operation of modern mobile networks, as it underpins load forecasting for congestion avoidance and missing-data imputation for continuity despite transmission errors. While deeply connected, forecasting and imputation have historically evolved as separate sub-fields. Existing models are typically task-specific, decouple temporal and spatial modeling, and rely on cascaded designs that accumulate errors and latency. Meanwhile, adapting pre-trained LLMs for this domain often leaves spatial structure under-guided and tends to overfit on limited data. translated_title: U-STS-LLM：一种用于流量预测与填补的统一时空引导大语言模型
translated_abstract: 准确的时空蜂窝流量分析是现代移动网络可靠运行的基础，它支撑着用于避免拥塞的负载预测，以及在传输错误情况下保证服务连续性的缺失数据填补。尽管预测与填补密切相关，但历史上它们一直作为两个独立的子领域发展。现有模型通常是任务专用的，将时间建模与空间建模解耦，并依赖会累积误差和延迟的级联设计。与此同时，将预训练大语言模型（LLM）适配到该领域时，往往对空间结构的引导不足，并且容易在有限数据上过拟合。为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了U-STS-LLM，一个构建在部分冻结的时空注意力（PFSTA）LLM主干之上的统一框架。一个动态时空注意力偏置生成器合成持久的函数图与瞬态节点状态来引导注意力，同时一个轻量级并行……（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出U-STS-LLM统一框架，基于部分冻结的时空注意力LLM主干，利用动态时空注意力偏置生成器引导注意力，将蜂窝流量预测与缺失数据填补两大任务统一处理，解决了现有模型任务专用、时空建模解耦、级联误差累积以及过拟合等问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes U-STS-LLM, a unified framework built on a partially frozen spatio-temporally attentive LLM backbone, which leverages a dynamic spatio-temporal attention bias generator to steer attention, unifying cellular traffic prediction and imputation while addressing task-specific designs, decoupled spatial-temporal modeling, cascaded error accumulation, and overfitting issues.
